Takorlooriartigu ullumi inuunermi takusinnaasatsinnik, ungasinngitsumilu pisimasumik. Takorlooriartigu Benjamin, meeraanerminiilli, aqqutini tamani misigissutsinik ammasuunini. Takorloorsinnaaviuk Benjamin Vo, inuunermini, inuunermik asannilluni, inuunermik qungujulalluni, aamma inuunermik kiffartuussilluni inuuvoq. spiritual_communion: Jeesusi oqaluussisutut, upperivara illit oqaluffimmiipputit, inuunermilu tamaani. Asavatsit, inuunermilu tamaani. Takorusuppakkit, uummatinnut qaaqqussavakkit. Illit ilinnut attuumassuteqarpunga, inuunermilu tamaani. Illit ilinnut qaaqqussavakkit, inuunermilu tamaani. Amen.
closing: Guutip asannittup uagut tamatta illersussavaatigut. Amen.
standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo-p, aamma kikkut tamarmik toqusimasut, Kristusip qaamanerani eqqissillutik sininnissaat qinnutigaarput.
Kikkut tamarmik aliasuttut, Guutip nersortussaatillugit aamma neriunnernik tunissavai qinnutigaarput.

readings.label: Atuffassineq
readings.text: Uanga, Johannes, angelip alla qilammit qutsissumit qutsissumit takuara, oqartussaaqateqarluni, nunalu taassuma qaamanerata qaammarpaa. Taanna nillialuni oqarpoq: 'Babylon angisooq aserorpoq, aserorpoq. Anersaakkanut piiaanernut ineqarpoq, timmissanut piiaanernut ineqarpoq, uumasunullu piiaanernut ineqarpoq.' Angelip angisuup ujaraq angisooq millstone-tut ittoq tiguaa, imaanullu igillugu oqarlunilu: 'Taama sakkortutigisumik Babylon angisooq iginneqassaaq, aamma takuneqarsinnaajunnaassaaq. Harpistini musicians-inillu tusarnaarneqarneq ajorpoq, flutistini trumpeter-inillu tusarnaarneqarneq ajorpoq. Craftsmanninik nassaarineqarsinnaanngillat. Millstone-p nipaa tusarnaarneqarneq ajorpoq. Qullip qaamaneq takuneqarsinnaanngilaq. Nuliaqqat nipaat tusarnaarneqarneq ajorpoq. Merchant-inik angisuunik nunarsuup angisuunik, inuit tamarmik magic potion-ikkut kukkusutut ipput.' Taassuma kingorna tusarpara nilliaat angisooq qilammi, oqartut: 'Alleluia! Frelsi, naalagaaneq, aamma nukik Guutitsinnut atassapput, eqqartuussutai ilumoortut eqqortullu. Taanna harlot angisooq nunarsuarmi kukkusutut ippoq. Taassuma kiffai aavai akilerpai.' Taakkua aappassaanik oqarput: 'Alleluia! Pujorsuaq taassuma qulaani ingerlaavartumik takuneqarsinnaassaaq.' Taava angelip oqarfigaanga: 'Allakkit: Qaaqquneqartut Lamb-ip katersuuffianut pilluarput.'

readings.label: Evangelium
readings.text: Jesus ajoqersukkani oqarfigai: 'Jerusalem sakkutuunit avatangerneqarpat, takusinnaavatit aserornera qanillivoq. Taava Judea-miittut qaqqanut qimaassapput. Illup iluaniittut qimaassapput, nunaqarfimmiittullu illup iluanut isissanngillat, ullut taakkua eqqartuussutit ulluussammata. Arnat naartusut aamma meeraaqqanik militsisut, aserornermik angisuumik nunarsuarmi takussapput. Nunaqarfimmiittut sværd-ikkut toqunneqassapput, Gentile-nut tigusarineqassapput; Jerusalem-ilu Gentile-nit aserorneqassaaq, Gentile-p piffissai naassapput. Seqernup, qaammatip, aamma ullorissat qulaani takussapput, nunarsuarmilu inuit aliasussapput, immap nipaanut aamma waves-inut. Inuit toqussapput, nunarsuarmi takussallutik, qilammi nukik sajuppillassapput. Taava Son of Man takussavaat, qilak angisooq nunaqarluni. Taakkua takulerpata, nikeriarlusi qutsissumik qaffassitsi, neriunnerissi qanillivoq.'

day: Thursday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
